notes.summary: Customers see shipping coupon discount listed twice
details: Multiple tickets referencing coupon totals not matching the final charge.
Common pattern: user applies coupon, changes shipping method, sees discount duplicated.
notes.impact: Confusion and distrust in checkout totals; increased support volume for coupon-related issues.

notes.summary: Escalation: payout questions when shipping discount applied
details: Support asked whether shipping discounts should affect cobbler payout calculations.
No definitive policy reference was found in the ticket context.
notes.impact: Potential miscommunication risk if payout behavior is described incorrectly.
